The support team demonstrated strong technical expertise and responsiveness throughout the process, helping to customize the system to meet the operational requirements for polio campaign payments. A key area for improvement is the gradual transfer of skills and system ownership to the local T4D team. This can be achieved through structured hands-on training, mentorship, and periodic refresher sessions to strengthen the team's capacity for overall system administration, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Building local expertise will help ensure sustainable management of the HOPE system, reduce reliance on external support, and enhance the country's ability to independently support future polio payment operations
